title: Information Retrieval and Web Search
weeklyTopics: Introduction to IR models and methods
Link analysis: PageRank and HITS, topic sensitive link analysis
skills: vector space and boolean retrieval models
workloadNotes: Four programming assignments (40% total, up to 3 days late at 10% penalty per day), two synchronous exams (20% each), and a 5-person team term project with two checkpoints plus a final poster presentation (20%).
textbooks: Christopher D. Manning, Prabhakar Raghavan, and Hinrich Schutze, Introduction to Information Retrieval, Cambridge University Press, 2008 (required)
K. Sparck Jones and P. Willett, Readings in Information Retrieval, Morgan Kaufmann, 1997 (recommended)
Ricardo Baeza-Yates and Berthier Ribeiro-Neto, Modern Information Retrieval, Addison-Wesley, 1999 (recommended)
